title: Better Fire+
description: Controls the fire overlay when you have Fire Resistance. Press J to open the settings menu.
body:
**Better Fire+ is a client-side mod that lets you control the fire overlay while you have the Fire Resistance effect.**

Press J to open the menu, or set your own keybind in the Minecraft options.

Mod – Toggle the mod On/Off

Overlay Mode – Choose when the fire overlay should be hidden.

Works On – Choose which fire overlays the mod affects.

Fire Color – Change the color of the fire to any color you choose.

More updates will be coming soon!
